mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ${table}(pmid,doi,title,abstract_text,pub_year,journal_title,source_url, authors_json,affiliation_info,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,raw_payload,source_hash,fetched_at) VALUES
(#{row.pmid},#{row.doi},#{row.title},#{row.abstractText},#{row.pubYear},#{row.journalTitle},#{row.sourceUrl}, #{row.authorsJson},#{row.affiliationInfo},#{row.keywordList},#{row.meshHeadingsJson},#{row.grantsJson}, #{row.cncbBanksJson},#{row.rawPayload},#{row.sourceHash},NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary=1, relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), doi=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(doi),doi), pub_year=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(pub_year),pub_year), journal_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(journal_title),journal_title), title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(title),title), abstract_text=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(abstract_text),abstract_text), source_url=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(source_url),source_url), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), keyword_list=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), authors_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), grants_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(raw_payload),raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)

INSERT INTO genbase_publication(paper_id,pmid,doi,paper_title,publish_year,journal_name,source_url,raw_payload, openlb_status,abstract_text,affiliation_info,keyword_list,authors_json,mesh_headings_json, grants_json,cncb_banks_json,openlb_raw_payload,is_primary,is_related,relation_status,source_hash,fetched_at) VALUES
(NULL,#{r.pmid},#{r.doi},COALESCE(#{r.title},CONCAT('PMID ',#{r.pmid})),#{r.pubYear},#{r.journalTitle},#{r.sourceUrl},CAST(#{r.rawPayload} AS JSON), 'SUCCESS',#{r.abstractText},#{r.affiliationInfo},#{r.keywordList},#{r.authorsJson},#{r.meshHeadingsJson}, #{r.grantsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson},#{r.rawPayload},1,0,'PENDING',#{r.sourceHash},NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary=1, is_related=GREATEST(is_related,VALUES(is_related)), relation_status=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),'PENDING',relation_status), paper_title=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(paper_title),paper_title), abstract_text=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(abstract_text),abstract_text), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), keyword_list=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), authors_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), grants_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), openlb_raw_payload=IF(NOT(source_hash<=>VALUES(source_hash)),VALUES(openlb_raw_payload),openlb_raw_payload), source_hash=VALUES(source_hash)
